notes.title: INO - Game Release!
notes.content:
After almost 2 years of being greenlit the game is finally being released!
It has been a long wait, but the game finally came to light.

A huge thank you to all of you in the community who believed in the project. 

A lot of things happened in this time, and a lot of things in the game have changed in the meantime (mostly for the better), but I'm really glad this came to a close.

As a thanks to you, the game will have a 10% discount on release, so most of you that upvoted this can enjoy it!
